**Login** is client-side only. There is no password and no server call.
- `LoginComponent.login()` in `frontend/src/app/components/login/login.component.ts:33` checks that the name isn't blank and calls `AuthService.login(username)`.
- `AuthService.login()` in `frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts:16` trims the name and looks for an existing profile in `localStorage` under `ai_dnd_user_<lowercased username>`. If it finds none, it creates `{ username, campaigns: [] }`.
- `AuthService.persist()` writes the profile to that per-user key. It also writes it to the shared "current user" key `ai_dnd_user`, which is `STORAGE_KEY`.
- `isLoggedIn()` returns true when the `_profile` signal is non-null. `authGuard` in `frontend/src/app/services/auth.guard.ts` uses it and redirects to `/login` otherwise.
- After login, a user with no campaigns is sent to `/characters`. A user with campaigns stays on the login page to see their slots.
- `logout()` clears the signal and removes only `ai_dnd_user`. The per-user key stays, so logging in again with the same name restores the campaigns.

**Campaigns** are stored in the browser's `localStorage` only. `UserProfile.campaigns` is an array of `CampaignSlot` objects. The slot fields are `slotId`, `characterName`, `characterClass`, `characterRace`, `level`, `sessionId`, `characterId`, `lastPlayed` and `location` (`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts:128-143`). `AuthService` manages them through `addCampaign`, `updateCampaign` and `removeCampaign`. The server holds the character and session data. The slot only stores `characterId` and `sessionId` as pointers, and `resumeCampaign()` navigates to `/game/<sessionId>`.

**Deleting a slot leaves the server-side character in place.**
- `LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` (line 55) only calls `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)`. That filters the slot out of the array and re-persists the profile.
- It makes no API call. `game-api.service.ts` has no character or session delete method, and the worker has no such route. The only `DELETE` routes are `character_inventory` item drops, in `worker/src/routes/character.ts:137` and `worker/src/routes/shop.ts:105`.
- The character and session rows in the D1 database are therefore orphaned. They stay on the server with nothing in the client pointing at them.
